description: This file defines the interface for plugins within the WPEFramework, including plugin lifecycle management, notification, web communication, security, and WebSocket handling. It declares several classes and interfaces that plugins must implement to integrate with the framework.

classes.name: IPlugin
classes.description: Main plugin interface for lifecycle management, notifications, and metadata retrieval.

classes.name: IPluginExtended
classes.description: Extension of IPlugin with communication channel attachment capabilities.

classes.name: ICompositPlugin
classes.description: Interface for composite plugins managing notifications and registration.

classes.name: IWeb
classes.description: Interface for handling web requests and responses.

classes.name: IChannel
classes.description: Interface for raw data channel communication.

classes.name: ISecurity
classes.description: Interface for security validation of requests and WebSocket upgrades.

classes.name: IAuthenticate
classes.description: Interface for token creation and security officer retrieval.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Called when a plugin changes state to active.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Called when a plugin changes state to inactive.

methods.name: Unavailable
methods.description: Called when a plugin becomes unavailable.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns metadata information about the plugin.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a communication channel to the plugin.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detaches a communication channel from the plugin.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification with the plugin.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification from the plugin.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests or WebSocket messages.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes a web request and returns a response.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming WebSocket or text socket data.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming raw data on a channel.

methods.name: Outbound
methods.description: Sends raw data over a channel.

methods.name: Allowed
methods.description: Checks if a WebSocket upgrade or request is allowed.

methods.name: Officer
methods.description: Retrieves the security officer interface for a token.
